name: DeepSeek V4 Vision Exp
short: DeepSeek's experimental native multimodal MoE (200K context) for image-to-code/UI reasoning; ZeroBench 35.0% topping Opus 4.8, free Zen tier.
modalities: Text, image, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free OpenCode Zen tier available for multimodal experimentation and vision benchmarking
standout: The UI-vision specialist: it reasons from screenshots into working code and topped a demanding visual benchmark against far larger models.
tradeoff: Experimental by name: a short context window and unproven stability make it a preview lane for image-to-code work, not a daily driver.
